examples.chinese: A：謝謝你。 B：不客氣。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ. B: Bú kèqi.
examples.english: A: Thank you. B: You are welcome.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你？ B:不客氣。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ? B: Bú kèqi.
examples.english: A: Thank you? B: You're welcome.

examples.chinese: 老師：你們有問題嗎？ 學生：沒有。謝謝老師。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī: Nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? Xuéshēng: Méi yǒu. Xièxie lǎoshī.
examples.english: Teacher: Do you have any questions? Student: No. Thank you, teacher.

examples.chinese: 老師：你們有問題嗎？學生：沒有。謝謝老師。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī: Nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? Xuéshēng: Méi yǒu. Xièxie lǎoshī.
examples.english: Teacher: Do you have any questions? Student: No. Thank you, teacher.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: A:你要不要去樓下的客廳看電視？ B:謝謝，我想先去樓上的房間休息。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào qù lóuxià de kètīng kàn diànshì? B: Xièxie, wǒ xiǎng xiān qù lóushàng de fángjiān xiūxi.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the living room downstairs to watch TV? B: Thanks, I want to go to the room upstairs to rest first.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 員工：謝謝您幫了我一個大忙，這個小禮物請您收下。 主管：你太客氣了！這點兒小事真的沒什麼。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng: Xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yī gè dà máng, zhège xiǎo lǐwù qǐng nín shōuxià. Zhǔguǎn: Nǐ tài kèqì le! Zhè diǎnr xiǎoshì zhēn de méishénme.
examples.english: Employee: Thank you for doing me a big favor; please accept this small gift. Supervisor: You're too polite! This little thing really is nothing serious.

examples.chinese: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.
examples.english: Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you.

examples.chinese: 謝謝！明天晚上六點來我家，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Xièxie! Míngtiān wǎnshang liù diǎn lái wǒ jiā, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: Thanks! How about coming to my place at 6 p.m. tomorrow?

examples.chinese: 找您七百八十五塊錢，謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎo nín qī bǎi bāshíwǔ kuài qián, xièxie.
examples.english: Here is your 785 dollars of change, thanks.

examples.chinese: 謝謝，這是我去年的生日禮物。
examples.pinyin: Xièxie, zhè shì wǒ qùnián de shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: Thanks, this is my birthday gift from last year.

examples.chinese: 好，謝謝醫生。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, xièxie yīshēng.
examples.english: Okay, Thank you doctor.

items.wordHook: 謝(thank), said twice: 謝謝(thank you).

examples.chinese: A:這些點心夠不夠？ B:夠了，夠了，我們已經吃過午飯了。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē diǎnxin gòu bu gòu? B: Gòu le, gòu le, wǒmen yǐjīng chī guo wǔfàn le.
examples.english: A: Are these snacks enough? B: Enough, enough; we have already eaten lunch.

examples.chinese: A:這個照相機是誰的？ B:是我爸爸的。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège zhàoxiàngjī shì shéi de? B: Shì wǒ bàba de.
examples.english: A: Whose camera is this? B: It's my dad's.

examples.chinese: 那個照相機貴得不得了，我買不起。
examples.pinyin: Nàge zhàoxiàngjī guì de bùdéliǎo, wǒ mǎi bù qǐ.
examples.english: That camera is extremely expensive; I can't afford to buy it.

examples.chinese: 我承認你的照相機是被我弄壞的，我一定負責把它修理好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chéngrèn nǐ de zhàoxiàngjī shì bèi wǒ nòng huài de, wǒ yīdìng fùzé bǎ tā xiūlǐ hǎo.
examples.english: I admit that your camera was broken by me; I will definitely take responsibility for fixing it.

examples.chinese: 這支手機的照相功能很強，拍出來的效果比照相機還要好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī shǒujī de zhàoxiàng gōngnéng hěn qiáng, pāi chūlái de xiàoguǒ bǐ zhàoxiàngjī hái yào hǎo.
examples.english: This phone's camera function is very strong; the effect of the photos taken is even better than that of a camera.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛在學校附近看到中明。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng zài xuéxiào fùjìn kàndào Zhōngmíng.
examples.english: I just now saw Zhongming near the school.

examples.chinese: 山本良介還在台灣學中文，他的中文課明年二月才結束。我今天有三個小時的數學課，剛剛才下課。
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè hái zài Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, tā de Zhōngwén kè míngnián èr yuè cái jiéshù. Wǒ jīntiān yǒu sān ge xiǎoshí de shùxué kè, gānggāng cái xiàkè.
examples.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke is still studying Chinese in Taiwan; his Chinese course will only end next February. I had three hours of math class today and just got out of class.

examples.chinese: 你剛剛說要吃漢堡，現在說要吃炸雞，到底要吃什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gānggāng shuō yào chī hànbǎo, xiànzài shuō yào chī zhàjī, dàodǐ yào chī shénme?
examples.english: You just said you wanted to eat a hamburger, and now you say you want to eat fried chicken—what on earth do you want to eat?

examples.chinese: 他們剛剛在燒竹子的時候，火非常大。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen gānggāng zài shāo zhúzi de shíhou, huǒ fēicháng dà.
examples.english: When they were just burning bamboo, the fire was very big.

examples.chinese: 剛剛大家推來推去的，結果把瓶子給打破了，這算誰的錯？
examples.pinyin: Gānggāng dàjiā tuīlái tuīqù de, jiéguǒ bǎ píngzi gěi dǎpò le, zhè suàn shéi de cuò?
examples.english: Just now everyone was pushing it back and forth, and as a result the bottle got broken—whose fault is this considered to be?

examples.chinese: 我剛剛忘了把垃圾拿出去丟，還好你提醒我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng wàng le bǎ lèsè ná chūqù diū, háohǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ.
examples.english: I just forgot to take the garbage out to throw away—good thing you reminded me.

examples.chinese: 你那一付筷子剛剛掉到地上弄髒了，我再幫你換一付新的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ nà yī fù kuàizi gānggāng diào dào dìshàng nòng zāng le, wǒ zài bāng nǐ huàn yī fù xīn de.
examples.english: That pair of chopsticks of yours just fell on the ground and got dirty; I'll help you exchange them for a new pair.

examples.chinese: 你很餓嗎？為什麼吃得這麼快？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hěn è ma? Wèishénme chī de zhème kuài?
examples.english: Are you very hungry? Why are you eating so fast?

examples.chinese: 帶這麼重的東西，走了兩個小時，我覺得很累。
examples.pinyin: Dài zhème zhòng de dōngxī, zǒu le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, wǒ juéde hěn lèi.
examples.english: Carrying such heavy things and walking for two hours, I feel very tired.

examples.chinese: 那麼我們現在去找他。
examples.pinyin: Nàme wǒmen xiànzài qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Let’s go ask him now.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 小王手裡提著那麼多東西，好像很重，我們過去幫他提一些吧！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng shǒu lǐ tízhe nàme duō dōngxi, hǎoxiàng hěn zhòng, wǒmen guòqù bāng tā tí yīxiē ba!
examples.english: Xiao Wang is carrying so many things in his hands; they look heavy. Let's go over and help him carry some!

examples.chinese: 這道菜能夠這麼好吃，是因為加了特別的醬料，還有自己做的醬油。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài nénggòu zhème hǎochī, shì yīnwèi jiāle tèbié de jiàngliào, hái yǒu zìjǐ zuò de jiàngyóu.
examples.english: This dish can be so delicious because it has special sauce added, plus homemade soy sauce.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: A:怎麼回事？外面怎麼這麼吵？ B:鄰居在修理屋頂，快修理好了，你忍耐一下吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Zěnme huí shì? Wàimiàn zěnme zhème chǎo? B: Línjū zài xiūlǐ wūdǐng, kuài xiūlǐ hǎo le, nǐ rěnnài yīxià ba.
examples.english: A: What's the matter? Why is it so noisy outside? B: The neighbor is repairing the roof; it will be fixed soon, so please put up with it for a bit.

examples.chinese: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài cái sānshí suì jiù yǐjīng shì míngpái fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, zhème niánqīng jiù yǒu zhèyàng de chéngjiù, shízài bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: Little Dai is only thirty years old and is already the big boss of a famous brand clothing company; to have such accomplishments at such a young age is really not simple.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 老闆為了感謝員工為公司付出這麼多，決定親手做菜請大家吃。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn wèile gǎnxiè yuángōng wèi gōngsī fùchū zhème duō, juédìng qīnshǒu zuò cài qǐng dàjiā chī.
examples.english: To thank the employees for contributing so much to the company, the boss decided to personally cook a meal and invite everyone to eat.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english: Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.
examples.english: Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person.

examples.chinese: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 父母對孩子表現的肯定，就是給孩子最好的鼓勵。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ duì háizi biǎoxiàn de kěndìng, jiùshì gěi háizi zuì hǎo de gǔlì.
examples.english: Parents' affirmation of their children's performance is the best encouragement for the children.

examples.chinese: 為了在這場鋼琴演奏中有優秀的表現，小戴早晚不停地練習。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zài zhè chǎng gāngqín yǎnzòu zhōng yǒu yōuxiù de biǎoxiàn, Xiǎo Dài zǎowǎn bùtíng de liànxí.
examples.english: In order to have an excellent performance in this piano performance, Xiao Dai practices non-stop morning and evening.

examples.chinese: 當別人表現得很好時，別忘了為他們鼓掌，給他們鼓勵。
examples.pinyin: Dāng biérén biǎoxiàn de hěn hǎo shí, bié wàngle wèi tāmen gǔzhǎng, gěi tāmen gǔlì.
examples.english: When others perform well, don't forget to applaud for them and give them encouragement.

examples.chinese: 球員的表現讓教練不斷搖頭，並表示得加強平常的訓練。
examples.pinyin: Qiúyuán de biǎoxiàn ràng jiàoliàn bùduàn yáotóu, bìng biǎoshì děi jiāqiáng píngcháng de xùnliàn.
examples.english: The players' performance made the coach constantly shake his head, and he indicated that they need to strengthen their regular training.

examples.chinese: 樂團主唱的唱歌技巧，對樂團演出表現的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Yuètuán zhǔchàng de chànggē jìqiǎo, duì yuètuán yǎnchū biǎoxiàn de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: The lead vocalist's singing skills have a considerable impact on the band's performance.

examples.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
examples.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

examples.chinese: 小戴在這場籃球比賽中表現相當優秀，投中了三十多分，因此被教練選中，代表學校參加全國比賽。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎodài zài zhè chǎng lánqiú bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn xiāngdāng yōuxiù, tóu zhòng le sānshí duō fēn, yīncǐ bèi jiàoliàn xuǎn zhòng, dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā quánguó bǐsài.
examples.english: Xiaodai performed quite excellently in this basketball game, hitting over thirty points, and was therefore selected by the coach to represent the school in the national competition.

examples.chinese: 孫小姐最近談成了幾筆大生意，表現出色，於是公司決定提高她的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Sūn xiǎojiě zuìjìn tán chéng le jǐ bǐ dà shēngyì, biǎoxiàn chūsè, yúshì gōngsī juédìng tígāo tā de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: Miss Sun recently closed several big deals and her performance was outstanding, so the company decided to raise her salary.

examples.chinese: 我的球隊因為練習不夠，這一季的表現也不太理想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiúduì yīnwèi liànxí bú gòu, zhè yí jì de biǎoxiàn yě bú tài lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Because my sports team didn't practice enough, its performance this season is also not ideal.

examples.chinese: 小龍受不了在那個又熱又髒的工廠工作，只做了三天就離開了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolóng shòubuliǎo zài nàge yòu rè yòu zāng de gōngchǎng gōngzuò, zhǐ zuò le sān tiān jiù líkāi le.
examples.english: Xiaolong could not bear to work in that hot and dirty factory; he only worked for three days and then left.

examples.chinese: 滑雪是很刺激的活動，需要很好的技巧。李小姐受不了離婚的刺激，已經好幾天吃不好、睡不好了。
examples.pinyin: Huáxuě shì hěn cìjī de huódòng, xūyào hěn hǎo de jìqiǎo. Lǐ xiǎojiě shòu bù liǎo líhūn de cìjī, yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān chī bù hǎo, shuì bù hǎo le.
examples.english: Skiing is a very exciting activity that requires good skills. Miss Li couldn't handle the shock of divorce, and has been unable to eat or sleep well for several days.

examples.chinese: 小韓一直受不了臭豆腐的味道，昨天終於克服了心理障礙，把臭豆腐吃下去了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán yīzhí shòu bù liǎo chòu dòufu de wèidào, zuótiān zhōngyú kèfú le xīnlǐ zhàng'ài, bǎ chòu dòufu chī xiàqù le.
examples.english: Xiao Han has always been unable to stand the smell of stinky tofu; yesterday he finally overcame his psychological obstacle and ate the stinky tofu.

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 電腦展內的人太多了，大家擠來擠去的，真是受不了。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo zhǎn nèi de rén tài duō le, dàjiā jǐ lái jǐ qù de, zhēn shì shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: There are too many people inside the computer exhibition; everyone is crowding in and squeezing around—it's really unbearable.

examples.chinese: 每次我受不了工作壓力時，就會到湖邊散步，看到平靜的湖水，心裡就會平靜下來。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì wǒ shòubuliǎo gōngzuò yālì shí, jiù huì dào húbiān sànbù, kàndào píngjìng de húshuǐ, xīnlǐ jiù huì píngjìng xiàlái.
examples.english: Every time I can't stand the work pressure, I go for a walk by the lake; seeing the tranquil lake water, my heart becomes peaceful.

examples.chinese: 他一有不順心的事，就會嘮叨個沒完，有時真讓人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì yǒu bú shùnxīn de shì, jiù huì láodao ge méiwán, yǒushí zhēn ràng rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Whenever he has something unpleasant, he will nag endlessly; sometimes it really is unbearable.

examples.chinese: 坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。
examples.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē shí, yīpáng de lǚkè bùtíng de jiǎng diànhuà, chǎo de wǒ shòubuliǎo.
examples.english: When I was on the train, the passenger beside me kept talking on the phone, making such a noise that I couldn't stand it.

items.wordHook: Finding hardship hard to 受(receive) and 不(no) longer able to endure 了(clear): 受不了 means cannot bear.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 這幾箱書都是我念過的課本跟參考資料，打算送給育幼院的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ xiāng shū dōu shì wǒ niàn guò de kèběn gēn cānkǎo zīliào, dǎsuàn sòng gěi yùyòuyuàn de háizi.
examples.english: These few boxes of books are all textbooks and reference materials I've studied; I plan to give them to the children at the orphanage.

examples.chinese: 購物網站會把常見的購物問題及處理方式放在網頁上，提供給顧客參考。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù wǎngzhàn huì bǎ chángjiàn de gòuwù wèntí jí chǔlǐ fāngshì fàng zài wǎngyè shàng, tígōng gěi gùkè cānkǎo.
examples.english: Shopping websites will put commonly seen shopping problems and how to handle them on their web pages, providing them for customers' reference.

examples.chinese: 無論發生什麼事，她都會跟父母商量，並參考他們的意見。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme shì, tā dōu huì gēn fùmǔ shāngliang, bìng cānkǎo tāmen de yìjiàn.
examples.english: No matter what happens, she will discuss it with her parents and refer to their opinions.

examples.chinese: 這項研究計畫只針對少部分區域實驗，參考價值不高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū jìhuà zhǐ zhēnduì shǎo bùfèn qūyù shíyàn, cānkǎo jiàzhí bù gāo.
examples.english: This research project only conducts experiments in a small number of areas, so its reference value is not high.

examples.chinese: 張老師認真觀察學生們的表現，這樣才能了解他們的心理和學習情況。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī rènzhēn guānchá xuéshengmen de biǎoxiàn, zhèyàng cái néng liǎojiě tāmen de xīnlǐ hé xuéxí qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Teacher Zhang carefully observes the students' performance; only in this way can she understand their psychology and learning situation.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡觀察小動物走來走去的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan guānchá xiǎo dòngwù zǒu lái zǒu qù de yàngzi.
examples.english: I like to observe the way small animals walk back and forth.

examples.chinese: 這種植物的葉子尖尖的，流出來的汁又臭又黏，觀察時要小心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de yèzi jiān jiān de, liú chūlái de zhī yòu chòu yòu nián, guānchá shí yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: The leaves of this plant are pointy, and the sap that flows out is both smelly and sticky; be careful when observing it.

examples.chinese: 那個廚師很有一手，能用一條魚做出五道菜。
examples.pinyin: Nàge chúshī hěn yǒu yīshǒu, néng yòng yī tiáo yú zuò chū wǔ dào cài.
examples.english: That chef is very skilled; he can make five dishes from one fish.

examples.chinese: 廚師們都會好好保養他們的用具，以免影響做菜的品質。
examples.pinyin: Chúshīmen dōu huì hǎohǎo bǎoyǎng tāmen de yòngjù, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng zuò cài de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: Chefs all take good care of their utensils, so as to avoid affecting the quality of their cooking.

examples.chinese: 他順利當上那家大飯店的廚師後，好多朋友都打電話祝賀他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shùnlì dāngshàng nà jiā dà fàndiàn de chúshī hòu, hǎoduō péngyǒu dōu dǎ diànhuà zhùhè tā.
examples.english: After he successfully became a chef at that big hotel, many friends called to congratulate him.

examples.chinese: 參加廚師比賽，只要味道部分的分數很高，就有機會得獎。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā chúshī bǐsài, zhǐyào wèidào bùfèn de fēnshù hěn gāo, jiù yǒu jīhuì déjiǎng.
examples.english: In a chef competition, as long as the score for the taste section is high, there is a chance to win a prize.

items.wordHook: Working in the 廚(kitchen) as a skilled 師(teacher): 廚師 means cook, chef.

examples.chinese: 我罵他是因為他太可惡了，你要我別生氣，我真的忍不住。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mà tā shì yīnwèi tā tài kěwù le, nǐ yào wǒ bié shēngqì, wǒ zhēnde rěn bù zhù.
examples.english: I scolded him because he was too detestable; you want me not to get angry, but I really cannot help it.

examples.chinese: 當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ tīngdào bèi gōngsī lùqǔ de xiāoxi shí, hái yǐwéi shì zuòmèng, rěnbuzhù yònglì niēle zìjǐ yīxià.
examples.english: When I heard the news that I was hired by the company, I still thought I was dreaming, and I couldn't help but pinch myself hard.

examples.chinese: 這道菜味道獨特，香味及顏色也很迷人，讓人忍不住流口水。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài wèidào dútè, xiāngwèi jí yánsè yě hěn mírén, ràng rén rěnbuzhù liú kǒushuǐ.
examples.english: This dish has a unique flavor, and its aroma and color are also very charming, making people unable to resist drooling.

examples.chinese: 我新學的舞蹈很複雜，常忘了什麼時候前進或後退。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīn xué de wǔdǎo hěn fùzá, cháng wàng le shénme shíhou qiánjìn huò hòutuì.
examples.english: The dance I'm newly learning is very complicated; I often forget when to move forward or backward.

examples.chinese: 腦部血管很複雜，做腦部手術時不能有任何的差錯。
examples.pinyin: Nǎobù xuèguǎn hěn fùzá, zuò nǎobù shǒushù shí bùnéng yǒu rènhé de chācuò.
examples.english: The blood vessels in the brain are very complex; when performing brain surgery, there must not be any mistake.

examples.chinese: 我話先說在前頭，要是你不照他所說的去做，等後頭出了問題，情況可就更複雜了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huà xiān shuō zài qiántou, yàoshi nǐ bù zhào tā suǒ shuō de qù zuò, děng hòutou chū le wèntí, qíngkuàng kě jiù gèng fúzá le.
examples.english: I'll say this first (up front): if you don't do as he says, when problems arise later, the situation will become even more complicated.

examples.chinese: 雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
examples.pinyin: Diāokè yùqì de jìshù hěn fùzá, mùqián duōbàn háishì zhǐ néng kào réngōng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: The technique of carving jade is very complex; at present, most of it can still only be handled by hand.

examples.chinese: 這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái shípǐn jiāgōng shèbèi de gòuzào xiāngdāng fùzá, qízhōng yuē sān fēn zhī yī de língjiàn hái shì yóu guówài jìnkǒu.
examples.english: The structure of this food processing equipment is quite complex, and about one third of its parts are still imported from abroad.

items.wordHook: a 勹(wrap) rests gently around a sleeping 巳(curl) → 包(wrap).
工(labor) + 作(do) → doing labor is 工作 "work".
a 木(tree) stands like a 奇(strange) perch → the 椅(chair).
Leather (皮) wrap (包) → a wallet is a leather wrap for your money.
a 糹(silk) takes the 工(work) dye → a wedding banner of 紅(red).
醫(doctor) + 院(institution) → the institution for doctors, a hospital.
Combining 隨(follow) and 便(easy): 隨便 means careless.
Combining 颱(platform) and 風(wind): 颱風 means typhoon.
